hypothesis: M170 and M171 both improved the fixed outcome objective while failing full boundary replay, so the fixed objective is not sufficiently aligned with actual replay retention for stage2 PPO.
success_criteria: compare M168, M170, and M171 fixed objective losses against full M164 replay outcomes
extract lost and changed success-drop rows for M170 and M171
identify whether failures are row67-only, row-swap, normal-success regression, or broader replay mismatch
document whether PPO should be paused until a replay-aligned objective or stricter prescreen is added
do not run another stage2 PPO candidate before the mismatch audit is complete
failure_criteria: try another PPO recipe before explaining the M170/M171 mismatch
treat fixed objective improvement as sufficient for admission
ignore rows 70 and 77 because row67 was retained in M171
relax full M164 replay or fragile-row guard thresholds

commands.name: m172_stage2_objective_replay_mismatch_audit
commands.command: Audit M168/M170/M171 fixed objective and boundary replay artifacts, especially lost rows 67, 70, and 77, before any further PPO stage.

decision_rule: Pause stage2 PPO unless the audit defines a replay-aligned objective or guard that directly protects the observed lost rows.
